title: HMW gDNA Extraction from Prokaryotic Cultures and Cryo Preservation Stocks
author: Richard Stöckl
materials: Optional: repeat go to step #17 once

steps.title: Prepare cell suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer ~50 µL bacterial/archaeal suspension from a cryo‑preservation capillary to a 1.5 mL tube, or alternatively pellet a well‑grown culture by centrifugation at 15,000 rpm for 15 min (temperature not specified), discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in ~50 µL media.

substeps.instruction: Transfer ~50 µL suspension from cryo capillary to a 1.5 mL reaction tube
Or centrifuge culture at 15,000 rpm for 15 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in ~50 µL media

steps.title: Add TE buffer and lysozyme
steps.instruction: Add 490 µL TE buffer (user‑provided) and 20 µL freshly prepared lysozyme (10 mg/mL in TE, Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #L6876), then vortex briefly.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL lysozyme (10 mg/mL in TE, Catalog #L6876)

steps.title: Lysozyme digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 30 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K, RNase A, SDS
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL, New England Biolabs, Catalog #P8107S), 10 µL RNase A (10 mg/mL, New England Biolabs, Catalog #T3018L), and 15 µL 20 % (w/v) SDS (Roth, Catalog #CN30.3); vortex briefly.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL, Catalog #P8107S)
Add 10 µL RNase A (10 mg/mL, Catalog #T3018L)

steps.title: Freeze‑thaw treatment
steps.instruction: Freeze the tube at –80 °C for 30 minutes, then thaw at 60 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Repeat 56°C incubation
steps.instruction: Repeat the 56 °C incubation (step “Proteinase K incubation”) two additional times, for a total of three 1‑hour incubations at 56 °C.

steps.title: Add NaCl
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 5 M NaCl (P212121) and mix well; this maintains the required ≥0.5 M salt concentration for CTAB precipitation.

steps.title: Add CTAB solution
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL of 10 % (w/v) CTAB (Serva, Catalog #16530) prepared in 700 mM NaCl (P212121), then mix.

steps.title: CTAB incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 30 minutes at 65 °C.

steps.title: Chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add one volume (~750 µL) chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1, Roti‑C/I, Carl Roth, Catalog #X984.2), shake vigorously, centrifuge at >12,000 rcf for 2 minutes at room temperature, and transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer aqueous phase to new tube

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, Roti‑Aqua‑P/C/I, Carl Roth, Catalog #X985.2), mix, centrifuge at >12,000 rcf for 2 minutes at room temperature, and transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube.

substeps.instruction: Add equal volume phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, Catalog #X985.2)
Transfer aqueous phase to new tube

steps.title: Final chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1, Roti‑C/I, Carl Roth, Catalog #X984.2), mix, centrifuge at >12,000 rcf for 2 minutes at room temperature, and transfer the aqueous phase to a 1.5 mL LoBind tube (Eppendorf, Catalog #022431021).

substeps.instruction: Add equal volume chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1, Catalog #X984.2)
Transfer aqueous phase to LoBind tube (Catalog #022431021)

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 0.6 volumes (~360 µL) cold 100 % isopropanol (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #190764) and 0.06 volumes (~36 µL) 3 M sodium acetate trihydrate (pH 5.2, Carl Roth, Catalog #3856.1), then mix.

substeps.instruction: Add ~36 µL 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2, Catalog #3856.1)

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16,000 rcf for 20 minutes at room temperature, discard the supernatant, and air‑dry the pellet briefly.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 0.6 volumes cold 70 % ethanol (P212121, Catalog #BE‑BDH1156), mix, centrifuge at 16,000 rcf for 10 minutes at room temperature, discard the supernatant, and air‑dry briefly.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 50 µL nuclease‑free water (NEB, Catalog #B1500S) or Buffer EB (Qiagen, Catalog #19086); optionally let the solution rest at 4 °C for several hours.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 50 µL nuclease‑free water or EB buffer
Optional: incubate at 4 °C for several hours
